title: URI fields: full RFC 3986 URI syntax at decode
description: Mark (2026-10-17). Supersedes mimid-1wgh.5.35. Applies to protocol-06 IdentifierUri (§5.2) and room-policy-04 Uri (Appendix B). A non-empty URI field must match the RFC 3986 §3 'URI' production (scheme required, fragment allowed, relative references rejected; implies ASCII-only). Empty still decodes and means absent where decisions allow it (mimid-1wgh.5.27, mimid-1wgh.3.18). Parse only, never normalize; re-encode emits received bytes. Parser: iri-string =0.7.14 (UriStr). MediaType in room-policy (and later mimi-mls) gets the same strictness: RFC 6838 §4.2 type/subtype and RFC 2045 parameter tokens, empty type only where ext-10 §6.2.2 allows it.
